text:
Armoured Phantoms
​
Introduction
Armoured phantoms are the highest tiered Zemouregal's undead, requiring 113  to kill. Even though their drops are worth less than that of other similar high-levelled slayer monsters such as abyssal lords  and moss golems , they offer competitive XP rates and make for a fairly speedy task.
​
They can be killed for following tasks:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Armoured phantoms, assigned by The Raptor and Laniakea
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Zemouregal's undead, assigned by The Raptor
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Undead cluster, assigned by The Raptor and Laniakea
​
Stats
⬥  XP per kill : 2625 + 866.2 
⬥  XP per kill : 2500
⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~900 (~800 AFK , ~630 AFK )
⬥ Optimal  XP per hour: ~2.2M (~2M AFK)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These rates do not include other factors such as , ‎ ‎ or  or other XP boosts.
​
Desirable Drops
⬥ Greater Sonic Wave ability codex 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 3 times rarer off-task.
⬥ Often killed for very high XP rates.
​
Useful Items and Unlocks



















Item unlocks
⬥ Scrimshaw of Sacrifice 
    • Can be used for 50% increased  and  exp
    • Feasible for AFKing at the cost of all drops.
⬥ Scrimshaw of Vampyrism

⬥ Salve amulet (e) 
    • Crucial for good KPH (and accuracy if using ).
⬥ Essence of Finality with a Dragon Halberd  
    • Good AoE spec to use if killing them actively with 
​
Passive unlocks
⬥ Upgraded kinetic cyclone  
    • Triggers  healing if using melee actively.
⬥ Dwarf multicannon  
    • For aggression in AFK methods.
⬥ Undead slayer (perk) 
    • Increases damage and KPH.
⬥ Undead slayer (sigil) 
    • Increases damage and KPH if slaying actively.
